base: black-and-white editorial vintage documentary photograph, desaturated, high contrast, grainy film texture. WIDE HORIZONTAL LANDSCAPE orientation, 3:2 aspect ratio, much wider than tall. FRAMING IS CRITICAL: the camera is CLOSE and the subject is VERY LARGE, filling the entire BOTTOM THREE QUARTERS of the frame from the left edge to the right edge, extending past the bottom edge. Only a NARROW BAND across the very TOP of the frame, about one fifth of the height, is empty pale bright almost-white wall or light, completely free of objects. EVERYTHING IS IN SHARP CRISP FOCUS, deep depth of field, no blur, no bokeh, no soft focus. This is ONE single real photographic exposure, never a composite: every element shares the same light and grain. THE TOP OF THE FRAME IS BRIGHT OVEREXPOSED LIGHT, and the transition from the scene into that light is GRADUAL and soft, as if the light swallows the upper part of the scene: NO horizontal edge anywhere, no shelf edge, no ceiling line, no sign, no roofline crossing the top. Surfaces and objects fade softly upward into the light. THE TOP BAND IS A HARD REQUIREMENT: that top fifth must be ONE single continuous evenly-lit pale surface spanning the FULL width, bright and uniform, with NOTHING crossing it at all: no shelf, no beam, no lamp, no head, no edge of any object. It must read as smooth blank paper. NO fog, NO mist, NO haze and NO smoke anywhere inside the scene itself; only that narrow band at the very top is pale. Natural unposed body language. Brazil, late 1970s; every sign, card, notebook, photograph, uniform or object in the scene is PLAIN and UNBRANDED: no printed brand names, no logos, no legible writing of any kind; any papers, notebooks, punch cards or photographs show only vague illegible marks, never readable letters or numbers. No text, no words, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no emojis, no gradients, no added color, no stock photo look.
cinema: CINEMATIC DIRECTION: camera at chest height, one strong directional light source raking across the scene, deep shadows, dramatic contrast. People LARGE and CLOSE, chest up, heads at about one fifth from the top of the frame. Every person is FULLY inside the frame: heads complete with clear empty space above them, nobody cropped at the neck, shoulders or waist, nobody touching the left or right edges.
fit: COMPOSITION FOR THE SLIDE (HARD REQUIREMENT): the subject occupies ONLY the LOWER 55 percent of the frame; the ENTIRE UPPER 45 percent of the frame is a plain, flat, evenly lit surface in a very pale OFF-WHITE tone (like unbleached linen paper, hex F3F3F3), with a faint fine texture and absolutely nothing on it: no shelves, no objects, no doorway, no window, no sign, no ceiling line, no heads. That pale surface is part of the photograph and simply continues upward, staying very pale and uniform to the top edge.

images.scene: A Brazilian man in his fifties, dress shirt with sleeves rolled up, sits at the wooden counter of a small neighborhood bar, elbows on the counter, a small coffee cup in front of him, looking STRAIGHT INTO THE CAMERA with a serious, frank expression, about to say something. LARGE, chest up. Behind him only the bare pale wall of the bar.

Early morning, still dark outside the window, in the simple kitchen of a working-class Brazilian home: a man in plain work clothes drinking coffee STANDING UP, his wife pouring coffee from an enamel pot, and their son of about ten in pajamas sitting at the small table with a school notebook (illegible). All three LARGE, heads in the lower half of the frame; the bare pale kitchen wall above them.

The owner, a Brazilian man in his fifties, sitting ALONE at night in the small office of his own business, the only light a desk lamp on his desk, looking across the empty room where chairs are pushed under empty desks. He is LARGE in the foreground, chest up, head in the lower half; the bare pale wall behind him. NO other people.

Inside a nearly EMPTY city bus before dawn: a worker in a plain uniform sitting by the window, his forehead resting against the glass, eyes closed, a metal lunchbox on his lap. LARGE, chest up, head in the lower half; above him the pale interior of the bus reading as one bare pale surface. NO other people in the frame.

Still life: an OLD framed photograph standing on a wooden desk, showing a young man ALONE in front of a small shop with the roll-up door half open and a ribbon across the entrance on inauguration day (his face and the shop sign blurred and illegible); a pen and a coffee cup beside the frame. The frame is LARGE in the lower half of the frame; the bare pale wall behind it. NO PEOPLE outside the photograph.

A simple wooden plank FOOTBRIDGE over a small stream in the Brazilian countryside in the morning; a man in plain work clothes crossing it, seen from the side, mid-stride, carrying a cloth bag. The bridge and the man fill the lower half of the frame; above them only pale, bright, overexposed sky reading as one bare pale surface.

The same wooden plank footbridge over a stream seen from BEHIND: TWO men crossing side by side toward the far end, one in a dress shirt with a loosened thin tie, the other in a plain work uniform, walking in step, backs to the camera, LARGE in the lower half of the frame; above them only pale, bright, overexposed sky reading as one bare pale surface.

Still: the wooden plank footbridge over the stream with TWO PLANKS BROKEN in the middle, the gap clearly visible, and beside the bridge a worn DIRT PATH through the grass that goes around the stream. No one on it. The bridge fills the lower half; above, pale bright overexposed sky as one bare pale surface. NO PEOPLE.

The owner and an employee sitting on the SAME side of a simple wooden table, the owner LISTENING with an open notebook and a pen held still, the employee talking with his hands, both turned slightly toward each other; LARGE, chest up, heads in the lower half; the bare pale wall behind them.

Still: a wall-mounted mechanical TIME CLOCK with a metal rack of punch cards beside it, one card yellowed, soft and worn from years of use standing among new white cards (all illegible). The clock and the rack are LARGE in the lower half of the frame; the bare pale wall above. NO PEOPLE.

The owner standing calm in the doorway of a small workshop, arms relaxed, watching his team work: at a workbench an experienced worker teaching a younger one, both in plain work clothes. The owner LARGE in the foreground, the two smaller behind; all heads in the lower half; the bare pale wall above.

The owner sitting on the front step of his own small business at the end of the day, the roll-up door half lowered behind him, elbows on his knees, looking STRAIGHT INTO THE CAMERA with a calm, direct expression; LARGE, chest up; above him the plain pale wall of the facade continuing to the top edge.
